summary: Play complete solo or pass-and-play backgammon on one Kobo.
release_notes: New match asks before clearing scores and history; cancelling keeps your game, while starting preserves player mode and match length. How to play keeps every rule visible at all text sizes in portrait and landscape.
page_description: Play complete backgammon on one Kobo, solo against a modest computer player or pass-and-play with the board reversed between turns. Full legal-move rules, the doubling cube with the Crawford rule, match play to 7 points, undo, and autosave.
